alias-of:aiath_38>ai_36@3f1663.note: Isaiah names Aiath and Ezra names Ai. That they are one place is an outside identification, not stated here.

date:prophecies-of-malachi@04bd53.note: Malachi 1:1 gives no king or year. The BC date depends on outside dating.

date:prophecies-of-micah@cc8c46.note: Dated by the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah (mic.1.1). The BC years depend on outside chronology.
